verses.text: Look, the LORD is emptying the earth and laying it waste. He's turning it upside down and scattering the people who live on it.

The same thing will happen to ordinary people and priests, servants and masters, servant girls and mistresses, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, those who charge interest and those who pay it.
The earth will be emptied out and left completely ruined. The LORD has spoken this word.
The earth grieves and withers. The world weakens and fades. Even the people who thought they stood high above everyone else waste away.
The people who live on the earth have polluted it. They crossed the lines of the law, broke the statutes, and tore up the covenant that was meant to last forever.
That's why the curse has eaten up the earth, and the people living on it are found guilty. That's why they're burned up and so few are left.
The new wine mourns. The vines shrivel. Everybody who used to be cheerful lets out a sigh.
The tambourines go quiet. The sound of people celebrating comes to an end. The harp has no more joy to play.
Nobody's singing with their wine. Strong drink tastes bitter to the people who drink it.
The city is broken down and in chaos. Every house is shut tight. Nobody can get in.
People cry out in the streets for wine. Every bit of joy has gone dark. The land's laughter is gone.
The city is left empty and wrecked, and its gate has been smashed.
That's how it'll be among the peoples of the earth, like an olive tree after it's been shaken or a vineyard with only scraps left after harvest.
Those who remain will raise their voices. They'll shout over the LORD's majesty, calling out from the sea.
So give glory to the LORD in the east! Give glory to the name of the LORD, Israel's God, on the islands of the sea!

From the far ends of the earth we hear songs, “Glory to the righteous!” But I said, “I'm wasting away! I'm wasting away! Trouble for me!” The traitors have betrayed us. They've gone all in on betrayal.
Terror, a pit, and a snare are waiting for you, people of the earth.
Run from the sound that terrifies you and you'll fall into the pit. Climb out of the pit and you'll get caught in the snare. The windows above have opened, and the earth's foundations shake.
The earth cracks wide open. The earth is torn apart. The earth shakes violently.
The earth will stagger like somebody drunk and swing back and forth like a hammock. Its rebellion will weigh it down, and it'll fall and never get back up.
That day the LORD will punish the army of the powers up high and the kings down on the earth.
They'll be rounded up like prisoners in a pit and locked up. Many days later, they'll be dealt with.
Then the moon will be embarrassed and the sun ashamed. The LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and his glory will be right there before his elders.
